outline:
當企業在邁向資訊化與自動化的同時，智慧生產工程師需考量如何整合智慧製造與精實生產。本課程的目標在幫助學生瞭解智慧製造在工廠上的應用，學習建構所謂數位導向的企業。
Since business are moving toward information and automation, smart production engineers need to consider how to integrate smart manufacturing and lean production. The goal of this course is to help students understand the application of smart manufacturing in the factory and to learn to build a so-called digitalized enterprise.
schedule:
week 1-week 3數位優化與轉型
week 4-week 5智慧製造與數位科技(AI)應用
week 6 期中測驗
week 7-week 12 案例簡介
week 13-week 14 製造執行系統介紹與實作
week 15-week 16 案例簡介
week17-week 18 期末分組報告
assessment:
上課與出席40%
期中測驗20%
期末報告40%
